products.name: Heavy Duty Roller Track
description: Introducing the Heavy Duty Roller Track, the perfect solution for effortlessly moving heavy skips or stillages around your yard.

Made in the UK with durable components from our trusted range, each track features a fully galvanised mounting frame and is fully serviceable in case of wear or damage. Comes in pairs for convenient use.
